coordinates: cell = [x, y] on the 160x80 map grid (24 px cells). Every enemy stands in the cell above its floor plank. World x = engine x + 6. Engine y = top row of the 7-row band; floor (plank) row = engine y + 6. Field "floor" is engine y, as in mesto; plank row = floor + 6.
